name: GalleryLightbox
usage_hint: Fullscreen lightbox overlay triggered via DOM events. Renders a scrollable image viewer with thumbnail sidebar. Any element on the page can open it by dispatching `lx:lightbox:open`.
when_to_use: For gallery sections, lookbook grids, product detail pages, or any section with images that benefit from a fullscreen viewing experience. Mount once per page — all galleries share the same instance.
when_not_to_use: For inline image zoom (use ImageZoom). For product variant galleries with swatch selection (use ProductGallery). For single hero images that don't need expanded view.
anti_patterns: Mounting multiple GalleryLightbox instances on one page (one is enough — it's event-driven and page-level)
Dispatching lx:lightbox:open with an empty images array (renders empty overlay)
Using low-resolution thumbnails as main images (lightbox reveals lack of detail)
Not providing alt text in the images array (accessibility failure)

examples.label: Page-level lightbox (no props needed, listens for events)
